terms.meaning: 1 followed by 7 zeros: 1,00,00,000. It is 100 lakhs.
1 followed by 9 zeros. It is 100 crore, also called 1 billion.
1 followed by 6 zeros: 1,000,000. It is also 10 lakhs.

items.name: Writing a number in parts
items.formula: A number can be split in many ways

items.name: Rounding up or down
items.formula: Choose by what the situation needs
items.example: For 732 guests order 750 sweets, because rounding down would leave people out.

items.name: Nearest thousand, lakh or crore
items.formula: Look at the part below that place

items.name: Number of digits in a product
items.formula: m digits × n digits: m + n − 1 or m + n digits
items.example: 2 digits × 2 digits: 10 × 10 = 100 has 3 digits, and 99 × 99 = 9801 has 4.

mistakes.text: 1 million is 10 lakhs, not 1 lakh. 1 lakh has 5 zeros and 1 million has 6.
1 billion is 100 crore, not 1 crore. 1 crore has 7 zeros and 1 billion has 9.
A number cannot start with 0. The smallest 10-digit number using 0 to 9 once each is 1023456789, not 0123456789.
A 3-digit number times a 3-digit number never has 4 digits. 100 × 100 = 10000 already has 5.
